svg.aria-label: Allocator feature comparison; the mimalloc-pprof column is highlighted

g.text: Sourced cell by cell in docs/allocator-features.json. Upstream and Bun are the exact commits this fork pins to and ports from; jemalloc is the build in the benchmark lockfile. The measured row is the committed churn benchmark,
Process-wide eager purge, from any thread
Purge the calling thread's own memory
Sweep another thread's heap for it
Sub-page return inside a still-used page
Walk every live block in a heap
Live heap snapshot with a viewer
No fast-path cost while profiling is off
no ASan, no ETW; Valgrind gone
Windows MSVC as a first-class target
Windows malloc override via a redirect DLL
First-party Rust crate, full C API
macOS covered with no Apple hardware
Create and destroy your own heaps
Shared arenas under the per-thread layer
Opt out of the exit-time destructor
Every cell cites a source in docs/allocator-features.json
